install.notes: The fake backend and the acceptance gate need neither rex-gym nor its stack: fake.py is pure Python. The clone itself targets Python 3.7 and pins numpy 1.17.3, pybullet 2.8.3, gym 0.17.1, tensorflow 1.15.5 and tensorflow-probability 0.8 (requirements.txt:1-7, README.md:22-26); the sim backend (not run here) additionally needs those and rex_gym.playground imported for the RexWalk-v0 registration.
